eip155_chain_id.issue: Assign the unique production Rollup0 EIP-155 chain ID.

eez_rollup_id.issue: Register and publish the non-zero Rollup0 ID in the production EEZ deployment.

native_asset.issue: Define the production native asset and its Ethereum custody or backing invariant.

genesis_commitment.issue: Publish the production genesis artifact, predeploy bytecode, state root, block hash, and artifact digest.

evm_fork.issue: Select the production EVM fork schedule and activation rule.

eez_contract.issue: Publish the production EEZ address, runtime bytecode hash, and deployment transaction.

manager_contract.issue: Publish the production Rollup0 manager address, runtime bytecode hash, and deployment transaction.

manager_proof_context.issue: Pin MANAGER(n): the exact recent Ethereum block-number rule, getCustomData(uint64) encoding, canonical block-hash authentication, and failure behavior.

proof_system_contracts.issue: Publish every accepted production proof-system deployment and verification key.

deployment_block.issue: Publish the Ethereum activation block number and hash for the complete production profile.

value.candidate_rule: Any producer may submit a valid supported candidate.
value.selection_rule: The first applicable transition in canonical Ethereum transaction order advances Rollup0.
value.sibling_rule: Later siblings whose exact parent height, block hash, and state root are no longer the current settled cursor are stale and do not advance, even when the root value repeats.
value.effect_rule: Only a unique occurrence-preserving applied prefix established by exact transaction and receipt evidence is derivable.

finality_rule.value: A deterministically derived Rollup0 block is safe after canonical Ethereum settlement and finalized when the containing Ethereum block is finalized.

value.ommers_hash: Keccak-256 of the canonical RLP empty list.
value.gas_used: Exact cumulative execution gas, not exceeding gas_limit.
value.timestamp: Checked parent timestamp plus operation.slot_construction.block_interval_ms divided by 1000.
value.base_fee_per_gas: Canonical EIP-1559 value derived from the parent under the activated fee_market selection.
value.withdrawals_root: The active-fork empty-withdrawals root; the withdrawals list is present and empty when withdrawals are active.
value.blob_gas_fields: blobGasUsed is execution-derived and excessBlobGas is canonically parent-derived when the activated fork requires them.
value.parent_beacon_block_root: Zero when the activated fork requires this field.
value.requests_hash: Exact execution-request hash when the activated fork requires this field.
value.later_optional_fields: Present only when the activated fork schedule requires them and computed under that fork.
value.body_rule: No ommers; use the exact ordered user and system transaction body selected by the Rollup0 rules.
value.validation_rule: Recompute execution, receipts, withdrawals, requests, every commitment, and the complete sealed header and body from the authenticated parent.

fee_market.issue: Pin the production genesis base fee, EIP-1559 parameters, fee treatment, and funding policy.

eez_predeploys.issue: Publish production predeploy addresses and bytecode that conform to eez-evm@0.2-draft.

system_address.issue: Select the production Rollup0 system authority and deterministic authorization rule.

system_address_safety.issue: Select and test enforcement that prevents arbitrary system-sender code execution, reentrant table replacement, and multiple inbound actions per transaction.

system_transaction_envelope.issue: Specify the production system transaction type, bytes, nonce, fees, gas, value source, reconstruction inputs, and failure rules.

value.acceptance_rule: Validators and provers evaluate every candidate received through a supported interface and accept each candidate that satisfies the active Rollup0 profile, regardless of producer identity.
value.invalid_candidate_rule: Reject a candidate on protocol validity grounds only; producer identity cannot make an invalid candidate valid or a valid candidate invalid.

value.identity_rule: Candidate producer identity is not a consensus input.
value.verification_rule: Authenticate the candidate bytes and all referenced chain data; do not require an allowlisted producer signature.

value.conflict_rule: Validators and provers may attest multiple valid siblings; the first sibling whose exact named parent is the current settled cursor when executed advances Rollup0.
value.stale_candidate_rule: A later sibling with a superseded parent height, block hash, or state root is stale and does not advance the cursor, including when only the root value still matches.

value.authorization_rule: No producer or relayer allowlist applies; any account or contract may submit an exact candidate that satisfies the activated proof and routing rules.
value.submission_rule: Process successful submissions in canonical Ethereum transaction order; the first applicable valid candidate advances Rollup0.
value.failure_rule: An invalid, incompletely proven, modified, or stale submission does not advance Rollup0 and gives its relayer no priority over another valid submission.

proof_budget_ms.issue: Pin the production candidate-construction and proof budget P in milliseconds.

submission_slack_ms.issue: Pin the production submission lead time S in milliseconds.

max_catch_up_blocks.issue: Pin C, the producer-side maximum blocks emitted at one catch-up trigger; C is not a candidate-range validity bound.

l1_l2_lowering.issue: Pin the deterministic field-by-field lowering from each supported settlement/execution action to its distinct L1 entry, L2 sidecar object, explicit inbound arguments, and exact system transaction, with rejection vectors.

max_candidate_range_blocks.issue: Pin N_max, the positive maximum number of execution-network blocks allowed in any candidate range as a consensus validity bound.

cursor_applicability.issue: Pin an enforceable settlement mechanism that compares the candidate's exact parent height, block hash, and state root with the current settled cursor and atomically advances to the authenticated selected prefix endpoint identity, including when roots repeat.

applied_prefix_safety.issue: Pin an enforceable mechanism that prevents a non-applied anchor or effect from allowing a later effect to apply, including when consecutive effects have repeated or equal root values.

atomic_inclusion.issue: Select and verify a production construction that enforces the required Ethereum companion-transaction order and all-or-none behavior.

max_user_transactions_per_bundle.issue: Set the production user-transaction and calldata capacity from measured execution, proof, relay, and Ethereum limits.

proof_routing_mitigation.issue: Bind the caller, transient prefix counts, complete calldata, contract and chain domain, replay protection, and front-running behavior outside the core 0.2 proof inputs.

value.attestation_model: Permissioned threshold of production validators or provers over permissionlessly produced candidates.
value.producer_neutrality: Each validator or prover evaluates all candidates received through its supported interface without producer allowlisting.
value.sibling_signing: A validator or prover may attest multiple valid siblings; attestations do not select the canonical sibling.
value.development_default: Mock proof mode, with no production validity claim.
value.production_mode: Not activated until membership, keys, threshold, binding, and governance are fixed.

allowed_proof_systems_and_vkeys.issue: Publish production proof systems, verification keys, validator or prover identities, and supported candidate interfaces.

threshold.issue: Set the production proof threshold and its rotation and failure rules.

requirement.value: Publish every transported user transaction and every derivation entry required for deterministic replay, preserving order and multiplicity.

channel.source: Rollup0 Network Specification §4.1 and Appendix B

codec.value: 0x00 followed by canonical RLP [blockTxCounts, transactions, l2_entries], with complete inner transaction and eez-evm@0.2-draft ABI consumption.

derivation_rule.value: Process candidates in canonical Ethereum transaction order, classify exact receipt-bound effects with order and multiplicity, accept only a unique applied prefix, and atomically replay every block and complete header.

manager_authority.issue: Publish the production manager authority, proof-policy change process, delays, thresholds, and state-recovery power.

upgrade_policy.issue: Publish contract, binding, profile, key, and parameter upgrade procedures with activation boundaries.

reorg_and_emergency_rule.value: Rewind to the last endpoint supported by canonical Ethereum history and derive the replacement branch; halt for an authenticated recovery decision if finalized settlement is displaced or the automatic history bound is exceeded.
